Andrew Carnegie sold his steel company for the equivalent of $400 billion in cash - more real cash than Elon Musk or Jeff Bezos have today, since theirs is mostly stock.

Musk and Bezos can't cash out without crashing their own stock price. Carnegie actually had the money sitting there.

So what did he do with $400 billion in cash? He gave almost all of it away and built libraries across America - something most people have never connected to his name.

Kevin Trudeau's point: the richest man in American history isn't remembered for the money. He's remembered for giving it away.
